The '''Mimbanese Liberation Army''', also known as the '''Mimbanese guerrillas''', was a resistance group of [[Mimbanese]] led by the tribal leader [[Iasento]], that in the early [[Imperial Era]] fought against the [[Galactic Empire]] during its [[Mimban Campaign|campaign]] to conquer their [[homeworld]] [[Mimban]]. The group had their origin during the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], where [[Iasento's tribe]] was [[Weapon|armed]] and trained by the Republic's [[224th Imperial Armored Division|224th Division]] in order to battle Separatist [[Battle of Mimban|invaders]] of the [[planet]]. Following the end of the Clone Wars, Iasento was forced to continue fighting<ref name="TOG" /> as the leader<ref name="Alien Archive" /> of the Mimbanese Liberation Army against a pacification campaign by the Galactic Empire's [[Moff]] [[Bin Essada]], who was attempting to strip Mimban of its resources like [[hyperbaride]] [[mineral]]s and in doing so destroyed its climate and [[plant]] life.<ref name="TOG" />

The Liberation Army camouflaged themselves with natural materials to disappear in the mud of the battlefields and utilized old Clone Wars era equipment and weapons like<ref name="TOG" /> the "[[Mimbanese blaster]]s"<ref name="SWCT">{{SWCT|set=Solo: A Star Wars Story - Gear & Gadgets|cardname=Mimbanese Blaster}}</ref> or [[F-78 blaster rifle]]s, which they modified with [[vibrobayonet]]s<ref name="TOG" />
